questions.help:
3 Moderate speed
 
All drivers should travel at a moderate speed and, if necessary, even stop their vehicle when the circumstances require it. The following are circumstances that are likely to be encountered and where speed should be moderated to take into account the given situation:
In the proximity of pedestrian crossings not regulated by traffic lights or personnel.
The proximity or locality of a market or shops, education centre or in places where it is foreseeable there may be children.
When encountering animals in the part of the road you are using or you can foresee there is a likelihood of this.
(Página 171 del manual 'Learning to drive')

ALCOHOL AND OTHER DRUGS  
   
18.1 Tests to detect alcohol and drugs  
If the test result is positive or even negative and the person presents obvious symptoms of being under the influence of alcohol, the investigating official will require a second test of exhaled air to test for alcohol. This provides further factual evidence and acts to compare the first test.

questions.help:
10 Head restraints
 
Head restraints are very effective in the event of a collision, avoiding or reducing the severity of injuries to the neck or vertebrates caused by the sudden movement, forward and back, of the head (whiplash). It is therefore imperative to properly use them, both in front and back seats.
Whiplash occurs when a person’s head moves backward and then forward suddenly with great force. It is particularly frequent in rear- ending collisions.
As well as muscle and head pain it can cause decreased neck mobility, vertigo or dizziness, among other symptoms.
(Página 80 del manual 'Learning to drive')

13 Intelligent Speed Assistant (ISA)
The system is linked to the TSR system, using a frontfacing camera and GPS in combination with a digital map to detect the speed limit for each stretch of road, informing the driver graphically through the instrument panel. It also automatically adapts the vehicle’s maximum speed to the limits in force on each stretch of the road, and does not allow the driver to accelerate beyond the speed allowed.
It can be activated and deactivated manually by clicking on a button or by pressing the accelerator.
